g.text: Plan a block. Follow your attention. Leave yourself a way back.
This tour introduces every part of the app, one step at a time. Reading it
does not start a timer, enable tracking, or change your preferences.
Use Next and Back, or the arrow keys. Skip anytime; press ? from the timer to
replay. On small terminals, scroll the text with your mouse wheel.
